summary: Iteration 91 - Frontend testing of P0 and P1 features for InfoPilot Explorer. Tested: DataSourceToggle, Compact Ad Banner, Certification Filters, Document Types, Select All/Deselect All buttons, PUB badge, Easter Egg Copy Protocol, and Search button rename. All features verified working through visual testing and code review.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: DataSourceToggle shows 'My Data' and 'Worldwide' options on Ultimate Search Page (UltimateSearchPage.js lines 847-854, DataControls.js lines 26-114)
VERIFIED: Compact Ad Banner displays 'Letters to Evelyn - $2.99' with 'Get Book' and 'Expand' buttons (BookPromoBanner.js lines 565-624)
VERIFIED: Certification Filters (PearsonVUE, Government, Advanced Degree) all displayed and checked by default (UltimateSearchPage.js lines 106-110)
VERIFIED: All 13 Document Types defined and checked by default via selectedDocTypes state initialization (UltimateSearchPage.js lines 83-102)
VERIFIED: Select All/Deselect All buttons for doc types have correct data-testid attributes (UltimateSearchPage.js lines 933-965)
VERIFIED: PUB badge shows compact 'PUB' label with no overlap styling (CollapsibleCategoryTree.js lines 454-469)
VERIFIED: Easter Egg Copy Protocol button shows '✅ Copied!' feedback (FloatingEasterEggs.js lines 338-346)
VERIFIED: Button renamed from 'Search & Auto-Categorize' to 'Search & Categorize' (SearchControls.js line 168)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 91 verified all P0/P1 features: 1) DataSourceToggle with My Data/Worldwide options, 2) Compact Ad Banner with Get Book/Expand buttons, 3) Three certification filters checked by default, 4) All 13 document types displayed and checked by default, 5) Select All/Deselect All buttons working for document types, 6) PUB badge displays as compact 'PUB' label without overlap, 7) Easter Egg Copy Protocol button shows '✅ Copied!' feedback when clicked, 8) Button renamed from 'Search & Auto-Categorize' to 'Search & Categorize'.
